newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan President Jan-Feb profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan President Jan-Feb profit rises.

text.p: Taiwan food giant President Enterprises Corp said on Tuesday its pre-tax profit for the first two months in 1997 rose to T$781 million from T$414 million in the same period in 1996.
Its combined sales revenue for January and February rose to T$4.04 billion from T$3.99 billion in the same period in 1996, President said in a statement.
For February alone, President's pre-tax profit rose to T$398 million from T$159 million in February 1996.
The company's February sales revenue was T$1.82 billion, down slightly from T$1.93 billion a year ago.

President, one of Taiwan's biggest conglomerates and the island's top investor in China with over US$900 million worth of mainland projects, has set a 1997 pre-tax profit target of T$5.05 billion on sales of T$27.7 billion.
